verdict.rationale: Segment's Data Storage Destinations (S3, warehouses) let raw events be archived, and Reverse ETL can extract warehouse data and sync it to new destinations, which could support backfilling a newly added tool — but this is inferred from adjacent features rather than a documented 'replay' capability. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a replay/backfill feature for re-sending previously archived events into destinations, retention/time-window guarantees, and any hands-on or independent confirmation this workflow works in practice.
